sites.name: Giza Plateau (Pyramids and Great Sphinx)
sites.what: Pyramids of Khufu, Khafre and Menkaure, the Great Sphinx and surrounding tombs.

access.opening: Daily 8 am to 4 pm on the ministry site page; 7 am to 5 pm on the ministry price list.
access.tickets: Foreign adult area entry EGP 700, student EGP 350; does not include entering the pyramids. Inside Khufu's pyramid EGP 1,000 (price list), Khafre EGP 280. No RBA rate for EGP.

ancient-sites-and-mysteries.summary: 2 sites in Giza. Opening hours differ between the ministry's site page and its price list.

layers.process: Giza Plateau area entry for foreigners: adult EGP 700 (about A$18.18), student EGP 350 (about A$9.09), at A$1 = about EGP 38.51 (Central Bank of Egypt average market rate for USD on 4 November 2026, EGP 54.70 mid, crossed with the RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = USD 0.7040). Open 8 am to 4 pm every day. The area ticket does not cover the Great Pyramid, the Pyramid of Khafre, the Pyramid of Menkaure, the Tomb of Meresankh III or the Workers' Cemetery, which have their own tickets. Vehicles pay too: car or taxi EGP 25, minibus EGP 50, coaster EGP 75, bus EGP 100.
Inside the Great Pyramid: foreign adult EGP 1,000 (about A$25.97), student EGP 500 (about A$12.98), on top of the area entry ticket. Listed hours 7 am to 5 pm.
